title: Three 6 Mafia & Bone Thugs-N-Harmony Fight Caused First Verzuz Commerical Break-In Battle History, Says Wiz Khalifa
htmlContent:
Last week, Verzuz was able to host the battle between Three 6 Mafia and Bone Thugs-N-Harmony. The battle did not conclude without controversy.

In the middle of the battle  Bone Thugs-N-Harmony member Bizzy Bone accused on of Three 6 Mafia affiliate by the name of Crunch Black of mocking him.

“Hey yo hey to before we even get started you ugly muthafuckas ain’t finna to be mocking me while I’m on muthafuckin’ stage,” Bizzy said. “OK straight the fuck up, and Gangsta Boo …”

Bizzy then chucked a bottle at Crunchy Black, and Juicy ran up on him as a result. “Suck my dick!” Juicy J said.

“Bizzy Bone, you a hater!” Gangsta Boo called out as tensions heated up. “You must not have taken your pills! What the fuck wrong with you bitch ass n-gga!?” Both groups, then swarmed each other, with security Bone Thugs’ longtime manager Steve Lobel hopping in the middle to break them up.

“Bizzy Bone needs to take his medicine!” Boo said in response.

Later that night Bizzy Bone apologized for his actions.

“I wanna apologize to everybody the fuck out there – on both sides,” Bizzy said. “I’m not trying to fuck this shit up. Pardon me. Let’s keep the muthafuckin’ party going.”

Bizzy and Juicy J hugged it out and buried the hatched.

On Friday night, Juicy J hopped on Instagram Live with Wiz Khalifa and during their chat, Juicy shared that he was glad everything went smoothly.

"Hey man, I am glad everything worked out on a cool level on some OG S***, stand up guy type of s***. Everything went smooth you know what I'm saying he [Bizzy Bone] apologized, so that was that. I'm glad the people tuned in," said Juicy J.

"I heard they went to a commercial break, I didn't know that bro?"

"That's the first commercial break ever dog," said Wiz Khalifia.
